source_plane.coverage_claim: bounded official European Union discovery pass over the Digital Services Act researcher-access enforcement and implementation plane; not a complete platform universe, not a count of individual access denials, and not evidence of absence outside the observed result set

capture_policy.retain: distinct official source pages or lifecycle matters that document the legal access gate, formal enforcement, a preliminary or final disposition, a corrective commitment, or a counterpower mechanism
capture_policy.exclude: machine-translated duplicates, duplicate summaries of the same decision, general overview pages already represented by a more specific instrument, and pages without a researcher-access proposition
capture_policy.deduplication_key: bounded matter plus enforcement or control stage

records.matter: DSA vetted-researcher access mechanism and portal
records.institution: European Commission / national Digital Services Coordinators / designated VLOPs and VLOSEs

source_packets.supports: Draft access procedures, portal design, data formats, and researcher-platform-DSC communication.
Independent vetting criteria, procedural harmonisation, documentation duties, and the data-access portal.
Legal obligation to comply with qualifying requests after DSC assessment.
Forty-nine applications received for assessment and Commission responsibility for enforcement.

records.source_supports: A separated public authority vets researchers and the Commission retains enforcement power over platform access obligations.
source_does_not_establish: that any particular application was granted
that requested data was delivered fully or on time
that the mechanism has prevented retaliation or restored a removed researcher
that observed research outcomes changed platform conduct
